_comment: American Volkssport Association traditional events (volksmarches): free, non-competitive 5/10 km walks run by local clubs, plus the few bike rides and swims on the same calendar. my.ava.org publishes no feed, so mapsee_ingest_ava.py reads the year list once and then each in-window event's page (the start-table window, the start place and the club's map pin). robots.txt on my.ava.org answers 404 (RFC 9309: no rules); legal.php is a software warranty disclaimer with no clause on automated access. Measured 2026-10-11: 166 events listed for the year, 122 within 120 days (Walk 112, Swim 6, Bike 3), 26 states. Read the adapter's header before changing a rule.
_within_days: Event pages are read only for events starting within this many days (one request each, at `pause`). 120 days is ~122 pages, about two minutes.
_run_weekdays: Wednesday and Sunday (0 = Monday). A club's walk is listed months ahead and rarely changes, so a daily read of ~120 pages from a volunteer association's server is wasted work. Wednesday is the feeds job's refresh day (the sync drops --only-new), so a changed start time reaches the stored row; Sunday adds what was listed since, and means one lost run costs three or four days rather than a week (the parkrun lesson).

_not_included.what: Seasonal and year-round self-guided routes (~2,084 for 2026)
_not_included.why: Behind the stateful POST search (find-an-event.php, state by state). A standing route open for months is not a dated event; taking them is a separate decision, not a rule of this adapter.
